selection.basis: Ten high-priority unresolved candidate price gaps with a previously reviewed official, dealer, or marketplace route that did not establish a current exact seller option. A new exact seller-item check can test whether current mainland order evidence is available. Selection follows the fresh gap inventory; no different models or fields are in scope.

targets.model: PARDUS Spark RS custom mechanical-105 build
Dengfu R20 Disc Gravel Bike Frame
PARDUS Robin EVO XS Dura-Ace competition build
Tavelo Arow SL custom complete build

research_route.action: Proceed sequentially in target order. For each exact model, make one focused public search for a current mainland seller item and open at most one exact item page. Record URL, accessed date, exact selectable model/build, visible CNY amount, seller identity at the shop level, availability/order path, and any limits. Return evidence only; do not edit repository files.
research_route.acceptance_rule: A seller-listed CNY amount can resolve the observation only when the exact target model and retained package/option match and the page exposes a current, orderable mainland seller item. A search snippet, official MSRP, foreign offer, unmapped option number, different trim, stale campaign, or price without current ordering context cannot resolve the gap.
research_route.stop_rule: At most one web attempt and one exact item page per model. Do not log in, contact sellers, use XHS, bypass access controls, loop retries, infer prices, or continue after a challenge/rate limit. If evidence is missing, mismatched, stale, or inaccessible, return the strongest supported no-result/rejected/blocked disposition and preserve the gap.

done_criteria: Return one concise evidence disposition per target with exact URL, observed/access date, exactness, seller/orderability evidence, and whether the amount is admissible.
After integrating evidence, add one bounded retry per target and update candidate price data only for admissible exact current seller observations.
Run focused validation, coverage acceptance/check, and npm run check once for the coherent batch.
Local B79 batch only; no push, pull request, merge, publication, or production action.
